papers.title: ORTHRUS, USENIX Security 2025
papers.implementation_decision: Sections 4.4–4.5: validation-calibrated node detection, then dependency reconstruction. Our heuristic does not reproduce its GNN or calibration.

papers.title: NODLINK, NDSS 2024
papers.implementation_decision: Detection terminals and connecting Steiner nodes serve different roles; no imported approximation guarantee.

papers.title: KAIROS, IEEE S&P 2024
papers.implementation_decision: Anomaly evidence, alert formation and reconstruction are distinct stages.

papers.title: Attack structure matters, Computers & Security 2025
papers.implementation_decision: Sections 3–5: node-set overlap misses causal structure. We audit directed temporal paths, but do not report SDTED without a complete ground-truth graph.

papers.title: Sometimes Simpler is Better, USENIX Security 2025
papers.implementation_decision: Fixed threshold grid, ablations and disclosure of development-only evaluation.
